d: Rixos Premium Qetaifan Island North offers guests a luxurious breakaway to an island packed with entertainment and adventure. With five acres of fun-filled attractions, including a sensational waterpark, private beach, retail area, a beach club, and numerous fine dining and casual restaurants, Rixos Premium Qetaifan Island North is the ultimate multi-inclusive vacation destination.
We are looking for a highly organized and service-oriented People & Culture Executive with hands-on experience in Waterpark, Theme Park, Resort, or high-volume hospitality operations.

The successful candidate will support the day-to-day People & Culture operations, including employee relations, payroll coordination, attendance and leave management, employee documentation, recruitment support, onboarding, and HR administration.
Hands-on experience with the Oasys payroll system is mandatory for this position.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
Minimum 3–5 years of relevant People & Culture / HR experience.
Previous experience in a Waterpark, Theme Park, large-scale resort, leisure attraction, or high-volume hospitality operation.
Hands-on experience with the Oasys payroll system is mandatory.
Strong knowledge of payroll inputs, attendance, leave, overtime, and employee records.
Experience supporting a large and diverse operational workforce.
Strong knowledge of HR administration and employee relations.
Excellent Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.
Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
Experience in Qatar or the GCC hospitality/leisure industry.
Experience working with seasonal or high-volume manpower.
Knowledge of Qatar Labour Law and HR practices.
Experience supporting large Waterpark/Theme Park operations.
Previous experience with HRIS/payroll and attendance systems in addition to Oasys.
r: Manage day-to-day People & Culture activities for Waterpark/Theme Park operational teams.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records and personnel files.
Prepare HR letters, certificates, contracts, confirmations, and other employee documentation.
Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and applicable labour requirements.
Support internal HR audits and maintain proper documentation.
Manage and maintain employee payroll-related data in the Oasys payroll system.
Process and verify monthly payroll inputs, including:
Reconcile payroll information with attendance and HR records before payroll submission.
Coordinate with Finance and relevant departments to resolve payroll discrepancies.
Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of all payroll and employee information.
Monitor daily attendance, absenteeism, late arrivals, and leave records.
Ensure timely and accurate updates of attendance and leave information.
Coordinate with department leaders regarding attendance irregularities and employee concerns.
Support the implementation and monitoring of attendance policies.
Support recruitment activities for operational and support functions.
Coordinate interviews, selection documentation, offers, and pre-employment requirements.
Support onboarding and induction programs for new employees.
Ensure employee files and joining documentation are complete before and after joining.
Support high-volume seasonal and operational recruitment requirements.
Act as a first point of contact for routine employee queries and People & Culture matters.
Support employee relations activities and escalate complex cases to the People & Culture Manager.
Assist in disciplinary procedures, investigations, warnings, and other employee relations documentation.
Support employee engagement activities, recognition programs, and People & Culture initiatives.
Maintain positive relationships with employees and operational departments.
Provide hands-on P&C support in a high-volume, fast-paced operational environment.
Understand the unique workforce requirements of Waterpark/Theme Park operations, including seasonal staffing, shift work, operational manpower fluctuations, and large frontline teams.
Support workforce planning and manpower movements during peak operational periods.
Work closely with operational departments such as F&B, Lifeguards, Guest Relations, Attractions, Security, Engineering, Housekeeping, and other park operations.

d: Calo is an app providing personalized meal plans for busy people through nutritional algorithms, built with love by chefs, nutritionists, and software engineers.

Launched in Bahrain in 2019, we have since expanded to 6 countries, delivered millions of meals to our customers, and are now expanding our mission of making healthy easy to retail and other verticals.
We're on a noble mission to make healthy easy. We think this is one of the most important problems to tackle in our world today. We have global ambitions - no small thinking here.

As a Product Developer on the Marketplace team, you will own one or more of Calo Market’s in-house CPG product lines end to end, from the initial brief to launch and ongoing performance. You won’t do every task yourself: you will lead the teams that do (NPD, Quality, Central Design, Supply Chain, Operations, Distribution and Marketing), set the deadlines, hold each team to its agreed SLA, and own the timeline, quality, cost and P&L of your line, including the decision to scale, fix or discontinue an SKU.
q: 3–5 years of experience in product development, category management, private label or NPD project management, ideally in CPG or food & beverage
A proven track record of taking physical products from concept to shelf
Experience working with manufacturers, co-packers or in-house kitchens, and with packaging and labelling
Commercial experience owning pricing, cost or P&L for a product line
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Food Science, Supply Chain or a related field
Native Arabic speaker, and fluent in English
Strong project management: running parallel workstreams against a fixed launch date
Ability to lead and influence teams you don’t manage directly
Working knowledge of food product development: recipe scaling, food costing, shelf-life testing and nutritional labelling
Understanding of packaging development: structure, materials, artwork and lead times
Familiarity with GCC food regulations and municipality registration is a strong plus
Commercial and analytical skills: pricing, margin analysis and sales tracking in spreadsheets
Clear, concise written communication: briefs, handoff packs, status updates and escalations
Comfortable working in Notion, Slack and Google Workspace
Ownership mindset: treats the line as their own business
Detail-oriented without losing sight of the launch date
Calm under pressure, and raises problems early rather than hiding them
Pro-active & direct communicator who holds others accountable with respect
Passionate about health, food and consumer products
Screening meeting with our TA team
r: Own assigned CPG lines end to end, from the line brief through launch and post-launch performance across GCC.
Work with cross functional teams to coordinate launching a star product, up to quality and on time delivery
Manage securing the supply for in-house or outsourced products
Own the PnL of the assigned CPG lines.
Track sales, margin and cost after launch, run the post-launch review, and take the call on whether to scale, fix or discontinue each SKU.
